selector.rationale: Intracellular yeasts with surrounding halos were identified on histopathological examination, which is a decisive finding for Cryptococcosis, especially in an immunocompromised patient

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: lack of characteristic dermoscopic features and histopathological findings

rejected.label: Sporotrichosis
rejected.why: no evidence of lymphocutaneous spread or sporotrichal dimorphism

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma
rejected.why: absence of characteristic histopathological features such as keratin pearls and atypical mitoses
